answer_2.quote: The quality of the generated audio samples is evaluated using three objective metrics: Fréchet Distance (FD), Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD) , and Kullback-Leibler divergence (KL) as used earlier in AudioLDM and Tango. ... We define nine metrics ... to evaluate whether the music properties in the generated music match the text prompts.
automatic_metrics: Chord Match in any Order major/minor Type (CMOT)

answer_4.quote: We conducted two rounds of subjective evaluation, each consisting of a general and an expert listening test that focuses on controllability. ... The participants were asked to rate the: i) audio rendering quality (AQ), ii) relevance of the audio with the input text prompt (REL), iii) overall musical quality (OMQ), iv) rhythm consistency (RC), and v) harmony and consonance of music (HC). For the expert listening test, we added two additional music control-specific aspects to rate the degree to which the chords and tempo from the generated music match the text prompt.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated on a 7-point Likert scale using the PsyToolkit interface. Full questions and interface used are shown in Appendix G.
